subject: Educational Psychology
stem: After a bell is repeatedly paired with food to produce salivation in a dog, a light is then paired with the bell alone (without food) until the light itself produces salivation. This extension of classical conditioning is called:
explanation: Higher-order conditioning uses an already-established conditioned stimulus (the bell) to condition a new stimulus (the light) — extending the conditioning chain beyond the original UCS.

subject: Educational Psychology
stem: After a conditioned response has been extinguished, it can sometimes reappear spontaneously after a rest period, even without further pairing with the UCS. This phenomenon is called:
explanation: Spontaneous recovery shows that extinction suppresses rather than erases the conditioned association — the response can briefly reappear after a rest period.
